garmin.title: Garmin Personal API
garmin.description: Import your activities, sleep and recovery data using your personal Garmin key.
garmin.createKey: Create a key on Garmin Connect

coros.title: COROS
coros.description: Connect your COROS account to read training data and send confirmed workouts, plans and routes.

reconcileHint: A read-only check is queued. The workout will not be sent again.
requestFailed: The request failed. Check the connection and try again.
regionHint: Choose the region where your account is registered. Credentials are never sent to another region automatically.
timezoneHint: Use the time zone configured in your provider account. Dates and sleep attribution follow this zone.
saveBeforeSync: Save your changed settings before starting a sync.
replaceConfirm: Replace the existing connection and cancel its pending jobs.
syncHint: Leave dates empty for the last 30 days, or select a historical range. Activities count as completed only after local processing finishes.
queued: Added to the sync queue. Progress is saved and shown below.
counts: Found {discovered} · Downloading {downloading} · Importing {importing} · Completed {imported} · Health data {healthDays} · Failed {failed}
disconnectHint: Disconnecting removes the local credentials and cancels pending jobs. Imported data stays. Offline backups may still contain encrypted credentials.
disconnected: Disconnected. Imported data has been kept.
revokeManually: Disconnected locally. Remote revocation could not be confirmed; remove access in COROS as well.
advancedHint: Read the provider’s original structured data, or use a supported COROS operation. These tools do not generate workouts or change local thresholds. Complex fields use the provider’s current JSON schema.
chooseResource: Choose a data type or operation
invalidJson: Check the JSON format of the complex fields.
sensitiveConfirm: I want to read the selected nutrition or menstrual data from my account.
writeHint: Writes require preview and confirmation. Saving to the library and scheduling are separate operations. Watch synchronization is not verified.
writeConfirm: Review the exact content above. Confirming sends it to COROS. Do not resend an operation with an unknown result; check the COROS app first.

errors.PROVIDER_FORBIDDEN: The provider has not authorized this data. Existing data is preserved; check account permissions or device support.
errors.PROVIDER_NOT_FOUND: The provider could not find this data. Existing records are preserved; this is not treated as a complete empty result.
errors.PROVIDER_HEALTH_DATE_MISMATCH: The returned health date differs from the requested date. The source is retained without updating daily metrics.
errors.PROVIDER_REQUEST_CONFLICT: This request ID belongs to a different sync range or settings. Start a new sync request.
errors.PROVIDER_LEASE_LOST: The task lost its execution lease and stopped before sending.
errors.PROVIDER_READBACK_MISMATCH: The remote content differs from the confirmed content. Success is unverified; read-only checks will continue.
errors.PROVIDER_RESULT_AMBIGUOUS: Multiple remote records may match. Check COROS; nothing will be sent again.
errors.PROVIDER_VERIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE: The provider has not supplied enough evidence to confirm success.
errors.PROVIDER_LOCAL_WORKOUT_CHANGED: The local workout changed after preview. Preview it again.
errors.PROVIDER_HEALTH_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED: The health source is saved, but its fields cannot yet be safely projected.
errors.PROVIDER_HEALTH_DATE_MISSING: The health data has no explicit date and was not added to daily metrics.
errors.PROVIDER_HEALTH_UNIT_UNSUPPORTED: The health unit is unsupported. No conversion was guessed.
errors.PROVIDER_HEALTH_CONFLICT: Conflicting values exist for the same daily health metric. Local metrics were not overwritten.
errors.PROVIDER_REMOTE_DELETED: Two complete checks confirmed removal of this activity source. Data from other sources is preserved.
errors.PROVIDER_AUTH_REQUIRED: Provider authorization is missing or expired. Reconnect your account.
errors.PROVIDER_RATE_LIMITED: Waiting for the provider’s request or FIT download allowance to recover.
errors.PROVIDER_BUSY: Another connection operation is running. Try again shortly.
errors.PROVIDER_SCHEMA_CHANGED: The provider returned an unrecognized structure. Nothing has been guessed or filled in.
errors.PROVIDER_STRUCTURED_RESULT_UNAVAILABLE: This provider tool did not return machine-readable data. Use file import for activities.
errors.PROVIDER_WINDOW_INCOMPLETE: The provider result reached its limit. This date range cannot be marked complete.
errors.PROVIDER_RESULT_UNKNOWN: The remote result is unknown. Check COROS before trying another delivery.
errors.PROVIDER_RECONNECT_CONFIRM_REQUIRED: Confirm replacement of the existing connection first.
errors.PROVIDER_CONNECTION_CHANGED: The connection changed. Start the operation again with the current connection.
errors.PROVIDER_TIMEZONE_INVALID: Enter a valid IANA time zone, such as Europe/London.
errors.PROVIDER_TIMEZONE_REQUIRED: Set your provider account’s time zone.
errors.PROVIDER_DATE_INVALID: Check the date format. COROS dates use YYYYMMDD.
errors.PROVIDER_DATE_RANGE_INVALID: The date range is invalid or outside the provider’s supported window.
errors.PROVIDER_ARGUMENTS_INVALID: The supplied fields do not match the provider’s current schema.
errors.PROVIDER_WRITES_DISABLED: Enable confirmed COROS writes in the connection settings first.
errors.PROVIDER_REMOTE_CHANGED: The remote workout or plan changed after preview. Read it again before making changes.
errors.PROVIDER_PREVIEW_EXPIRED: This preview expired. Create a new preview before confirming.
errors.PROVIDER_OAUTH_REGISTRATION_FAILED: COROS did not accept this app registration or callback address.
errors.PROVIDER_IMPORT_FAILED: The downloaded activity could not be imported. Check its import history.
errors.PROVIDER_SYNC_PARTIAL_FAILED: Some items failed. Check the job results; successful imports have been kept.
errors.PROVIDER_ARCHIVE_INVALID: The original activity archive is invalid, exceeds limits or contains ambiguous files.
errors.PROVIDER_DIRECTION_UNSUPPORTED: Garmin Personal API does not support writing training data.
errors.PROVIDER_CONNECTION_MODE_CONFLICT: This account already uses a different connection mode.
errors.PROVIDER_USE_ACTIVITY_SYNC: Use activity sync so download limits and import results can be tracked.
errors.PROVIDER_TOOL_MISSING: This operation is not currently offered by the provider.

garminSyncHint: Leave dates empty to queue the last 60 local calendar days. Existing data is merged; coverage is complete only when processing finishes. Select a smaller range to start with recent data.
syncError: Sync failed. Check the connection and try again.
